import torch
from typing import Dict, Tuple

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor,
                   targets: torch.Tensor,
                   heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   up_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   potentials: torch.Tensor,
                   prev_potentials: torch.Tensor,
                   actions: torch.Tensor,
                   dt: float) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:

    eps: float = 1e-6

    # ---------------- configuration ----------------
    w_forward: float = 1.0        # forward speed along the heading
    w_target: float = 0.5         # speed towards the target
    w_speed: float = 0.1          # overall horizontal speed
    w_upright: float = 0.5        # keep the torso upright
    w_alive: float = 0.2          # stay alive
    w_action: float = 0.005       # smoothness of the actions
    w_progress: float = 1.0       # potential based shaping (get closer to target)
    max_forward_speed: float = 10.0

    num_envs = root_states.shape[0]
    device = root_states.device

    # ---- world frame velocity of the torso ----
    vel = root_states[:, 7:10]
    vel_xy = vel[:, 0:2]
    speed = torch.sqrt((vel_xy * vel_xy).sum(dim=-1) + eps)

    # ---- heading direction (horizontal, world frame) ----
    heading_xy = heading_vec[:, 0:2]
    heading_norm = torch.sqrt((heading_xy*heading_xy).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_heading = heading_xy / heading_norm
    forward_speed = (vel_xy * dir_heading).sum(dim=-1)
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(forward_speed, -max_forward_speed, max_forward_speed)

    # ---- direction to the target ----
    to_target = targets[:, 0:2] - root_states[:, 0:2]
    to_target_norm = torch.sqrt((to_target*to_target).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_target = to_target / to_target_norm
    target_speed = (vel_xy * dir_target).sum(dim=-1)

    # ---- uprightness ----
    upright = torch.clamp(up_vec[:, 2], -1.0, 1.0)

    # ---- potential based progress ----
    progress = (prev_potentials - potentials) * dt

    # ---- action regularization ----
    action_cost = (actions * actions).sum(dim=-1)

    # ---- individual rewards ----
    r_forward = w_forward * forward_speed
    r_target = w_target * target_speed
    r_speed = w_speed * speed
    r_upright = w_upright * upright
    r_alive = w_alive * torch.ones(num_envs, device=device)   # or just w_alive
    r_action = -w_action * action_cost
    r_progress = w_progress * progress

    reward = r_forward + r_target + r_speed + r_upright + r_alive + r_action + r_progress

    components = {
        "forward_speed": r_forward,
        "target_speed": r_target,
        "speed": r_speed,
        "upright": r_upright,
        "alive": r_alive,
        "action_penalty": r_action,
        "progress": r_progress,
    }
    return reward, components

```python
@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor,
                   targets: torch.Tensor,
                   heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   up_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   potentials: torch.Tensor,
                   prev_potentials: torch.Tensor,
                   actions: torch.Tensor,
                   dt: float) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:

    eps: float = 1e-6

    # ---------------- reward weights ----------------
    w_forward_speed: float = 1.0     # forward (heading) speed of the torso [m/s]
    w_target_speed: float = 0.5      # speed towards the target [m/s]
    w_speed: float = 0.2             # horizontal speed magnitude [m/s]
    w_upright: float = 0.5           # torso upright
    w_alive: float = 0.2             # staying alive
    w_action: float = 0.005          # action magnitude penalty
    w_progress: float = 1.0          # potential based shaping

    max_speed: float = 10.0

    num_envs: int = root_states.shape[0]
    device: torch.device = root_states.device

    # --- torso state ---
    lin_vel = root_states[:, 7:10]
    vel_xy = lin_vel[:, 0:2]
    speed = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(vel_xy * vel_xy, dim=-1) + eps)

    # --- heading direction of the torso (world frame, horizontal part) ---
    heading_xy = heading_vec[:, 0:2]
    heading_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(heading_xy * heading_xy, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_heading = heading_xy / heading_norm
    forward_speed = torch.sum(vel_xy * dir_heading, dim=-1)
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(forward_speed, -max_speed, max_speed)

    # --- direction to the target (world frame, horizontal) ---
    to_target = targets[:, 0:2] - root_states[:, 0:2]
    to_target_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(to_target * to_target, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_target = to_target / to_target_norm
    target_speed = torch.sum(vel_xy * dir_target, dim=-1)

    # --- uprightness from the torso quaternion (w, x, y, z) ---
    quat = root_states[:, 3:7]
    qw = quat[:, 0]; qx = quat[:, 1]; qy = quat[:, 2]; qz = quat[:, 3]
    up_z = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)
    upright = torch.clamp(up_z, -1.0, 1.0)

    # --- potential based progress towards the target ---
    progress = (prev_potentials - potentials) * dt

    # --- action regularization ---
    action_cost = torch.sum(actions * actions, dim=-1)

    r_forward = w_forward_speed * forward_speed
    r_target = w_target_speed * target_speed
    r_speed = w_speed * speed
    r_upright = w_upright * upright
    r_alive = w_alive * torch.ones(num_envs, device=device)
    r_action = -w_action * action_cost
    r_progress = w_progress * progress

    reward = r_forward + r_target + r_speed + r_upright + r_alive + r_action + r_progress

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "forward_speed": r_forward,
        "target_speed": r_target,
        "speed": r_speed,
        "upright": r_upright,
        "alive": r_alive,
        "action_penalty": r_action,
        "progress": r_progress,
    }
    return reward, components

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor,
                   targets: torch.Tensor,
                   heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   up_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   actions: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    """Reward for making the ant run forward (towards the target) as fast as possible."""

    eps: float = 1e-6

    # ----------------------------- weights -------------------------------
    w_forward: float = 1.0      # speed along the heading direction of the torso
    w_target: float = 0.5       # speed towards the target
    w_speed: float = 0.2        # horizontal speed magnitude
    w_upright: float = 0.5      # keep the torso upright
    w_alive: float = 0.2        # survival bonus
    w_action: float = 0.005     # smoothness / energy penalty on the actions
    max_speed: float = 10.0     # clipping of the speed terms

    num_envs: int = root_states.shape[0]
    device: torch.device = root_states.device

    # --------------------- torso kinematics ---------------------
    lin_vel = root_states[:, 7:10]
    vel_xy = lin_vel[:, 0:2]
    speed = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(vel_xy * vel_xy, dim=-1) + eps)

    # --------------------- heading direction ---------------------
    heading_xy = heading_vec[:, 0:2]
    heading_len = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(heading_xy * heading_xy, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_heading = heading_xy / heading_len
    forward_speed = torch.sum(vel_xy * dir_heading, dim=-1)
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(forward_speed, -max_speed, max_speed)

    # --------------------- direction to the target ---------------------
    to_target = targets[:, 0:2] - root_states[:, 0:2]
    to_target_len = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(to_target * to_target, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_target = to_target / to_target_len
    target_speed = torch.sum(vel_xy * dir_target, dim=-1)
    target_speed = torch.clamp(target_speed, -max_speed, max_speed)

    # --------------------- uprightness ---------------------
    up_xy_len = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(up_vec[:, 0:2] * up_vec[:, 0:2], dim=-1) + eps)
    upright = torch.clamp(torch.abs(up_vec[:, 2]) - up_xy_len, -1.0, 1.0)

    # --------------------- action regularization ---------------------
    action_cost = torch.sum(actions * actions, dim=-1)

    # --------------------- reward components ---------------------
    r_forward = w_forward * forward_speed
    r_target = w_target * target_speed
    r_speed = w_speed * speed
    r_upright = w_upright * upright
    r_alive = w_alive * torch.ones(num_envs, device=device)
    r_action = -w_action * action_cost

    reward = r_forward + r_target + r_speed + r_upright + r_alive + r_action

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "forward_speed": r_forward,
        "target_speed": r_target,
        "speed": r_speed,
        "upright": r_upright,
        "alive": r_alive,
        "action_penalty": r_action,
    }
    return reward, components

import torch
from typing import Dict, Tuple

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor,
                   targets: torch.Tensor,
                   heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   up_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   potentials: torch.Tensor,
                   prev_potentials: torch.Tensor,
                   actions: torch.Tensor,
                   dt: float) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:

    eps: float = 1e-6

    # ---------------- configuration ----------------
    w_forward: float = 1.0        # forward speed along the heading
    w_target: float = 0.5         # speed towards the target
    w_speed: float = 0.1          # overall horizontal speed
    w_upright: float = 0.5        # keep the torso upright
    w_alive: float = 0.2          # stay alive
    w_action: float = 0.005       # smoothness of the actions
    w_progress: float = 1.0       # potential based shaping (get closer to target)
    max_forward_speed: float = 10.0

    num_envs = root_states.shape[0]
    device = root_states.device

    # ---- world frame velocity of the torso ----
    vel = root_states[:, 7:10]
    vel_xy = vel[:, 0:2]
    speed = torch.sqrt((vel_xy * vel_xy).sum(dim=-1) + eps)

    # ---- heading direction (horizontal, world frame) ----
    heading_xy = heading_vec[:, 0:2]
    heading_norm = torch.sqrt((heading_xy*heading_xy).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_heading = heading_xy / heading_norm
    forward_speed = (vel_xy * dir_heading).sum(dim=-1)
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(forward_speed, -max_forward_speed, max_forward_speed)

    # ---- direction to the target ----
    to_target = targets[:, 0:2] - root_states[:, 0:2]
    to_target_norm = torch.sqrt((to_target*to_target).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_target = to_target / to_target_norm
    target_speed = (vel_xy * dir_target).sum(dim=-1)

    # ---- uprightness ----
    upright = torch.clamp(up_vec[:, 2], -1.0, 1.0)

    # ---- potential based progress ----
    progress = (prev_potentials - potentials) * dt

    # ---- action regularization ----
    action_cost = (actions * actions).sum(dim=-1)

    # ---- individual rewards ----
    r_forward = w_forward * forward_speed
    r_target = w_target * target_speed
    r_speed = w_speed * speed
    r_upright = w_upright * upright
    r_alive = w_alive * torch.ones(num_envs, device=device)   # or just w_alive
    r_action = -w_action * action_cost
    r_progress = w_progress * progress

    reward = r_forward + r_target + r_speed + r_upright + r_alive + r_action + r_progress

    components = {
        "forward_speed": r_forward,
        "target_speed": r_target,
        "speed": r_speed,
        "upright": r_upright,
        "alive": r_alive,
        "action_penalty": r_action,
        "progress": r_progress,
    }
    return reward, components

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor,
                   targets: torch.Tensor,
                   heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   up_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   potentials: torch.Tensor,
                   prev_potentials: torch.Tensor,
                   actions: torch.Tensor,
                   dt: float) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:

    eps: float = 1e-6

    # ---------------- reward weights ----------------
    w_forward_speed: float = 1.0     # forward (heading) speed of the torso [m/s]
    w_target_speed: float = 0.5      # speed towards the target [m/s]
    w_speed: float = 0.2             # horizontal speed magnitude [m/s]
    w_upright: float = 0.5           # torso upright
    w_alive: float = 0.2             # staying alive
    w_action: float = 0.005          # action magnitude penalty
    w_progress: float = 1.0          # potential based shaping

    max_speed: float = 10.0

    num_envs: int = root_states.shape[0]
    device: torch.device = root_states.device

    # --- torso state ---
    lin_vel = root_states[:, 7:10]
    vel_xy = lin_vel[:, 0:2]
    speed = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(vel_xy * vel_xy, dim=-1) + eps)

    # --- heading direction of the torso (world frame, horizontal part) ---
    heading_xy = heading_vec[:, 0:2]
    heading_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(heading_xy * heading_xy, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_heading = heading_xy / heading_norm
    forward_speed = torch.sum(vel_xy * dir_heading, dim=-1)
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(forward_speed, -max_speed, max_speed)

    # --- direction to the target (world frame, horizontal) ---
    to_target = targets[:, 0:2] - root_states[:, 0:2]
    to_target_norm = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(to_target * to_target, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_target = to_target / to_target_norm
    target_speed = torch.sum(vel_xy * dir_target, dim=-1)

    # --- uprightness from the torso quaternion (w, x, y, z) ---
    quat = root_states[:, 3:7]
    qw = quat[:, 0]; qx = quat[:, 1]; qy = quat[:, 2]; qz = quat[:, 3]
    up_z = 1.0 - 2.0 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)
    upright = torch.clamp(up_z, -1.0, 1.0)

    # --- potential based progress towards the target ---
    progress = (prev_potentials - potentials) * dt

    # --- action regularization ---
    action_cost = torch.sum(actions * actions, dim=-1)

    r_forward = w_forward_speed * forward_speed
    r_target = w_target_speed * target_speed
    r_speed = w_speed * speed
    r_upright = w_upright * upright
    r_alive = w_alive * torch.ones(num_envs, device=device)
    r_action = -w_action * action_cost
    r_progress = w_progress * progress

    reward = r_forward + r_target + r_speed + r_upright + r_alive + r_action + r_progress

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "forward_speed": r_forward,
        "target_speed": r_target,
        "speed": r_speed,
        "upright": r_upright,
        "alive": r_alive,
        "action_penalty": r_action,
        "progress": r_progress,
    }
    return reward, components

@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward(root_states: torch.Tensor,
                   targets: torch.Tensor,
                   heading_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   up_vec: torch.Tensor,
                   actions: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    """Reward for making the ant run forward (towards the target) as fast as possible."""

    eps: float = 1e-6

    # ----------------------------- weights -------------------------------
    w_forward: float = 1.0      # speed along the heading direction of the torso
    w_target: float = 0.5       # speed towards the target
    w_speed: float = 0.2        # horizontal speed magnitude
    w_upright: float = 0.5      # keep the torso upright
    w_alive: float = 0.2        # survival bonus
    w_action: float = 0.005     # smoothness / energy penalty on the actions
    max_speed: float = 10.0     # clipping of the speed terms

    num_envs: int = root_states.shape[0]
    device: torch.device = root_states.device

    # --------------------- torso kinematics ---------------------
    lin_vel = root_states[:, 7:10]
    vel_xy = lin_vel[:, 0:2]
    speed = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(vel_xy * vel_xy, dim=-1) + eps)

    # --------------------- heading direction ---------------------
    heading_xy = heading_vec[:, 0:2]
    heading_len = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(heading_xy * heading_xy, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_heading = heading_xy / heading_len
    forward_speed = torch.sum(vel_xy * dir_heading, dim=-1)
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(forward_speed, -max_speed, max_speed)

    # --------------------- direction to the target ---------------------
    to_target = targets[:, 0:2] - root_states[:, 0:2]
    to_target_len = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(to_target * to_target, dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
    dir_target = to_target / to_target_len
    target_speed = torch.sum(vel_xy * dir_target, dim=-1)
    target_speed = torch.clamp(target_speed, -max_speed, max_speed)

    # --------------------- uprightness ---------------------
    up_xy_len = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(up_vec[:, 0:2] * up_vec[:, 0:2], dim=-1) + eps)
    upright = torch.clamp(torch.abs(up_vec[:, 2]) - up_xy_len, -1.0, 1.0)

    # --------------------- action regularization ---------------------
    action_cost = torch.sum(actions * actions, dim=-1)

    # --------------------- reward components ---------------------
    r_forward = w_forward * forward_speed
    r_target = w_target * target_speed
    r_speed = w_speed * speed
    r_upright = w_upright * upright
    r_alive = w_alive * torch.ones(num_envs, device=device)
    r_action = -w_action * action_cost

    reward = r_forward + r_target + r_speed + r_upright + r_alive + r_action

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "forward_speed": r_forward,
        "target_speed": r_target,
        "speed": r_speed,
        "upright": r_upright,
        "alive": r_alive,
        "action_penalty": r_action,
    }
    return reward, components
